title: Clarify the test-ref authority bullet: define the Merger role, Markdown-only inputs, and ref deletion versus force-push
outcome: Clarify the test-ref authority bullet: define the Merger role, Markdown-only inputs, and ref deletion versus force-push
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md define or reference who holds the Engram::Merger role and how it is assigned, so the test-ref grant names a lawful holder
The test-ref bullet states whether a Markdown-only input can qualify as merge-ready (it has no compile or tests), or says test refs are only for gated inputs
The bullet states that the force-push prohibition covers updating an existing ref and does not forbid the mandated ref deletion, and what happens when a same-name ref already exists
Landed under the authority-text rule (both coordinators' concurrence, notice to Greg, final-diff audit)
